svg.title: The noiseless growing lower bound is sensitive to small forbidden-event probabilities. A quantitative replacement is possible, with a poor large-grid margin that should be stated explicitly. Suppose a row-stochastic matrix eT factors through r classical states as AB, with both A and B row stochastic. Such a normalization is available for every nonnegative factorization of a stochastic matrix after zero factors are removed. Set e = maxi eTii and μ = mini̸=j eTij. For τ > 0 put Si = {l: Ail≥τ}. If Si ⊆Sj, then eTij ≤e/τ + rτ. (28)
